confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Los Angeles prices; no price searches or live listing checks were run. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by season and area, and July is peak season, so they are less certain. Figures are typical pre-tax, pre-tip listed prices. Cocktail and wine rest on typical LA bar pricing and sit at about 2.3x and 2x the beer anchor. FX came from search-result summaries of the RBA listing, not a directly opened page. A 15 Oct 2026 figure seen in one summary could not be confirmed, so 14 Oct is used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No supplied city is near Los Angeles price levels. Nara, Manila and Tbilisi were used only as lower-cost reference points to check plausible ratios. The 3-star to basic hotel ratio is about 1.7x here, versus 1.65x to 2.45x in the comparables. The dorm to private room ratio is about 0.4 here, versus 0.40 to 0.58 in the comparables. Los Angeles levels otherwise come from general knowledge of US urban prices.
